echoParts: Remember those who are in prison
as though in prison with them
since you also are in the body.
verseText: Remember those who are in prison, as though in prison with them, and those who are mistreated, since you also are in the body.
meaning: God calls us to remember and care about people who are imprisoned or mistreated, feeling their suffering as if it were happening to us.
